```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Sample data
df_pandas = pd.DataFrame({
    "store": ["A", "B", "A", "B", "A"],
    "revenue": [100, 200, 150, 250, 120],
    "items": [5, 8, 6, 10, 4]
})

df = nw.from_native(df_pandas)

# Compute per-store statistics
result = df.group_by("store").agg(
    total_revenue=nw.col("revenue").sum(),
    avg_items=nw.col("items").mean()
).sort("store")

print(result)
```
